classification: Static recovery of the startup ROM self-check. No repair, bypass, re-signing or ROM modification is implemented.

routine.name: startup_verify_rom_checksums

outer_gate.semantics: 66A5 returns before any record is verified when ROM 719B bit1 is set. The original image has 00, so bit1 is clear and the record loop runs.

routine.gate_semantics: 66A5 loads error_code=A from record+9 and gate=B from record+10, stores A in its scratch frame, and executes TSTB/BNE to skip verification when B is nonzero. 66DB executes SWI with B=error_code on failure. Only gate=00 records are active.

table.word_encoding: big-endian; for this selected image file offsets equal CPU addresses (see maps/rom-layout.json)

sum_xor.description: 8-bit additive sum and XOR over the inclusive start..end range. After processing FFD0 the pointer increments to FFD1 and is redirected to FFD6, so FFD1..FFD5 are excluded.

rotate_add.description: Instruction-exact 66DB loop: ROLB; ADCA ,X; RORB. The carry entering the next ROLB is the carry from CMPX #FFD3 (address comparison) after the increment, including the FFD3->FFD6 redirect. Only accumulator A is compared.

rotate_sub_xor.description: Instruction-exact 66DB loop: LSLB; ADCB #0; SUBB ,X; PSHS B; TFR A,B; three ASRB/RORA pairs; PULS B; EORA ,X. After processing FFD3 the pointer increments to FFD4 and is redirected to FFD6. A and B are compared.

provenance.source_note: Saved assembly exported from the documented local original workspace prerequisite-pass, now curated in native evidence. Computed values come from tools/Verify-RomIntegrity.ps1 emulating the saved instructions.

limitations: Only the gate-00 record is active. The three gate-FF records are reported as stored, not treated as active checks.
This certifies the self-check algorithm, range, fields and original expected values for the original image only. It does not repair, regenerate, bypass or re-sign a modified image.
Loader CRC/SHA warnings and the 68F1 characteriser challenge checks are separate integrity mechanisms and are not covered.
No natural MAME boot, gameplay or executable-semantics claim is made by this static report.
